Maya: Heads-up — scheduling preemptive NIC queue warmup + rolling node reboots for GPU racks in us-west2 to reduce transient packet drops during high-concurrency bursts. Window: Tue 2025-09-02 02:00–05:00 UTC. Plan below.

Owen: what's the expected impact on capacity? :thinking:

Maya: Short summary: each rack will be drained for ~12–15min, 3 racks at a time (staggered), estimated 5–7% capacity loss at peak. We'll keep autoscaler target slightly above baseline and shift low-priority batch to other regions. No Dedicated reservations will be preempted; we'll pin those hosts.

Sev: Can we stagger across AZs instead of contiguous racks? keeps cross-az redundancy.

Maya: Yes — we'll pick racks across az-a/az-b/az-c so the cluster still has enough spread. Staggering helps the KV cache warmups too.

Liam: Driver updates needed?

Maya: Not for this. It's NIC queue settings and kernel param tweaks to avoid XDP/hammer. No GPU driver change. Steps:
```
# example drain + warmup
kubectl drain gpu-node-123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=90
ssh infra@gpu-node-123 'sudo ethtool -K eth0 tx off rx off && sudo sysctl -w net.core.netdev_max_backlog=5000'
# run small synthetic workload to warm KV cache
./tools/kv_warmup.sh --node gpu-node-123 --duration 60
kubectl uncordon gpu-node-123
```

Anna: I can update the status page and SLA notes when you lock the final list. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Thanks — assigning: @Anna update status, @Liam monitor driver metrics, @Owen oversee autoscaler bump during window, @Sev run cross-az placement check. Oncall coverage: @InfraBot will create incident channel and page infra-oncall at start.

InfraBot: Scheduled maintenance created (ID: maint-20250902-01) — reminders at -60m and -5m. See https://infra.redwood/maint/maint-20250902-01

Owen: One more — cost impact? moving batch to other regions adds egress + spot delta.

Maya: Estimated incremental cost ~ $2.2k for the window (egress + spot premium). We'll absorb in infra ops budget; flagged to finance.

Sev: Suggest a fallback plan: if we see >10% request error rate, abort and rollback changes using the post-change snapshot.

Maya: Agreed — abort criteria documented. Will post runbook in this thread before EOD PST.

Anna: I'll queue the status update after you post the node list.

Maya: Posting final node list in 15m. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
